dog.description_text:
Please note: Any profiles with a "Pawling, NY" icon are located at the ASPCA Recovery & Rehabilitation Center, which is a 90-minute drive outside of the city. All other dogs are located in New York City.

Meet Quinn, who has a big personality and an even bigger love for playing ball!

Quinn loves spending time with people and has plenty of wiggles to prove it. But if there’s one thing that can compete for her attention, it’s a ball. Quinn is absolutely obsessed! Whether she’s chasing one or eagerly waiting for it to come back her way, ball time is serious business for this playful girl! When it’s time for a snack break, Quinn has opinions there, too. Spray cheese, jerky treats and even watermelon are on her list of favorites. With her happy wiggles, love of people and unmatched enthusiasm for playtime, Quinn knows how to make an impression. Click the “Adopt Me” button to connect with Quinn’s team in Pawling, New York!

*We encourage a $150 suggested adoption fee when adopting an animal. This adoption fee allows the ASPCA to continue our lifesaving work and help even more animals in need. We are grateful for any amount given at the time of adoption.*
dog.name: QUINN
